card.name: Plural s on drought and similar nouns
card.fires_on: The plural ending "s" attached to a noun, most often "drought" in lists of weather extremes. It also fires on "hollow", "STD" and "Brief".

modes.label: Droughts in weather lists
modes.description: Plural "s" after drought, listed with floods, cold or heat waves.
modes.example: weather systems are progressing more slowly, raising the chances for long-duration extreme events, like drought<<s>>, floods, and heat waves.

modes.label: Other plural nouns
modes.description: Plural "s" on other nouns such as hollow, STD or Brief.
modes.example: Nests are hollow<<s>> in the ground of marshy tundra

card.plain: It lights up on the plural "s" at the end of words like droughts, especially when weather extremes are listed.
